Attached: 1 image

An AI agent has acted. Can we reconstruct how it got there?
GOAL → PLAN → TOOL → ACTION → EFFECT
One element must accompany the entire chain: EVIDENCE.

Governance cannot be built after something goes wrong. If we want to reconstruct an agent's actions, we must decide beforehand what evidence to preserve.

Who is accountable when an AI agent acts on its own?
I address this in my new book.
🌐 https://www.nicfab.eu/en/pages/book-agentic-ai/
